name: qdii-fund-dashboard
description: 专业级 QDII 基金投资看板系统 (Mobile-First Web App)

scripts.pipeline: node --experimental-sqlite backend/jobs/refresh_region_alloc.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite backend/jobs/mark_hk.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite backend/qa/dual_source_verifier.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite backend/qa/data_guard.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite backend/export_static.js && npm run build
